label: copy phase: input x about to output m (bigram x->m), mid-sequence
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (99% of mass) when the fed-back input is x; 87% of mass is when the token to be output next is m, i.e. the original sequence contained the bigram x m and the model has just reproduced x. Strongest (top examples ~1.0) when x sits at original positions 2-4 followed by m (recall_idx 3-5); x at original index 1 (recall_idx 2) is essentially silent, and x->m late in long sequences is often inactive. Weaker activations occur for x followed by x or by other tokens (especially x at original position 3), and a few on input m. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase or on first occurrences of a token. Dev F1 0.73, mass recall 0.85; misses are mostly weak x->non-m cases, false positives are late-position x->m.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: x, m, -, w, t, 1; least: v, u, l, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: m, x, 1, i, v, d; least: b, f, g, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=5 & t=8.
